_snapshotData.name: Realty Income Corporation
_snapshotData.description: Realty Income Corporation, an S&P 500 company, is real estate partner to the world's leading companies. Founded in 1969, we serve our clients as a full-service real estate capital provider. As of June 30, 2026, we have a portfolio of over 15,500 properties in all 50 U.S. states, the U.K., and eight other countries in Europe. We are known as "The Monthly Dividend Company" and have a mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time. Since our founding, we have declared 674 consecutive monthly dividends and are a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats index for having increased our dividend for over 31 consecutive years. Realty Income Corporation was founded in 1969 and was incorporated in Maryland.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: Realty Income Corporation possesses a narrow economic moat (score: 50/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (strong) and Learning Curve (weak). Realty Income Corporation has strong supply-side economies of scale.

supply_side.explanation: Realty Income Corporation has strong supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 9.6% with earnings growing at 69.2% — positive 59.6% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 92.7% and operating margins of 47.0% at at current scale.

network_effects.explanation: Realty Income Corporation has limited demand-side economies of scale. REIT - Retail suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: Realty Income Corporation has weak learning curve advantages. REIT - Retail has limited knowledge barriers. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: Realty Income Corporation benefits from weak switching costs. REIT - Retail offers relatively easy substitution. 93% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 9.6% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: REIT - Retail has limited AI disruption risk. Physical infrastructure, regulatory moats, and tangible assets provide insulation.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: AI offers limited transformative potential for REIT - Retail. Benefits are primarily operational efficiency gains.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: Realty Income Corporation faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
